meanings.note: a place where old documents are kept

examples.trans: The documents are in the archive.

examples.text: Надоело мне в этом архиве сидеть.
examples.trans: I'm tired of sitting in this archive.

examples.text: Она с бабушкой живёт. Бабушка болеет всё время.
examples.trans: She lives with her grandmother. Grandma is ill all the time.

examples.text: Ну ладно, давай беги. Бабушке привет!
examples.trans: Okay, off you go. Say hi to Grandma!
What a progressive granny you are!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level?

examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level? We were ten percent ahead!

examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Мне нужно спокойно подумать перед дальней дорогой.
examples.trans: I need to think calmly before a long journey.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: masculine noun that declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: Значит, надо глубже копать! Дальние родственники, дедушки и бабушки.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
+ genitive: ни копейки = not a penny

examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.
